Where These Comparisons Come From

    Industry figures are averages across many businesses. They show context, not guarantees.

    Winning

    • Meta Leads20 guide leads in September at about $7 each.
    • Sign-UpsA church website build (a referral) and a new membership both signed up in September.
    • Follow-Up13 automations are live, so every lead gets followed up.

    Improving

    • Website Sign-UpsThe traffic ad sent 658 clicks, with no public form fills yet. The path from ad to form is the next fix.
    • Google Search12 searches showed the site on Google, 26 views and no clicks yet. Three name searches landed in the top 5. None of the 50 tracked searches rank yet, so this is the starting line.

    What This Means For You

    The ads are bringing in church leaders at a low cost and the follow-up is ready for them. The next gains come from turning website visits into sign-ups and from search starting to show up.
